title: Eurasia Group atisba T-MEC “zombie” con guerra comercial EU-Canadá
summary: Analistas de Eurasia Group consideran que el fracaso de las negociaciones comerciales entre EU y Canadá no implica la ruptura del T-MEC, sino que el escenario más probable (90%) es un “T-MEC zombi” que sobrevive con protocolos bilaterales y aranceles más altos. La consultora asigna 60% de probabilidad a que México y Canadá alcancen acuerdos bilaterales separados con Washington.

title: Crédito para las pymes: la otra oportunidad del T-MEC
summary: Pese a contar con un sistema financiero sólido, el crédito en México no llega con suficiente profundidad a las micro y pequeñas empresas, que representan más del 90% de las unidades económicas y 70% del empleo formal. El artículo señala que instituciones especializadas como la SOFIPO Finsus están cubriendo ese vacío de financiamiento que la banca tradicional no atiende.

title: El regreso del monopolio del poder
summary: El auge de la demanda energética de los centros de datos de IA está impulsando una ola acelerada de consolidación entre empresas de servicios eléctricos en EU, atrayendo el interés de inversionistas de Wall Street. El texto advierte que esta concentración recuerda a los conglomerados eléctricos de hace un siglo y podría elevar tarifas y debilitar la rendición de cuentas corporativa.

title: Colombia: pactan tasa de préstamos más baja por terremoto
summary: El presidente colombiano Abelardo de la Espriella acordó con los principales grupos financieros del país —Aval, GNB Sudameris y Bolívar/Davivienda— reducir al 8% anual la tasa de créditos de vivienda para las familias afectadas por el terremoto del 10 de agosto. La medida aplica únicamente en las regiones damnificadas.

title: Brasil potenciará capacidades en IA con más de 440 millones de dólares
summary: Brasil anunció inversiones por 2,300 millones de reales (444 millones de dólares) para fortalecer su ecosistema de inteligencia artificial, repartidas entre empresas estadounidenses y chinas. Más de la mitad del monto financiará un centro de supercómputo en Río de Janeiro con Huawei e iFlytek, mientras otra parte se destinará a un superordenador que el gobierno espera sea operado con chips de Nvidia.

title: A ‘democratised’ financial crisis is still a crisis
summary: The FT flags a boom in insurers backing private credit as a new source of hidden financial risk, arguing that spreading credit exposure more broadly doesn't eliminate systemic danger — it just obscures it. The piece warns that a ‘democratised’ financial crisis is still a crisis.

title: US widens AI-driven investment gap with Europe
summary: The Financial Times reports that the US is pulling further ahead of Europe on AI-driven investment, as American firms far outspend their European counterparts on high-tech equipment and data-center facilities. The gap underscores growing concern in Brussels about Europe's competitiveness in the AI race.

title: Germany must ditch doubts over private capital, says investment tsar
summary: Germany's investment envoy Martin Blessing says the country needs to overcome official skepticism toward private capital, warning that foreign investors currently face wary public authorities. The comments point to friction between Berlin's growth ambitions and its regulatory posture toward outside capital.

title: Nvidia Notifies Customers About AI-Related Price Hikes
summary: Nvidia has told its biggest customers that prices for AI-chip-equipped servers are rising more than 15% in many cases, driven by soaring memory chip costs. The increase signals tightening supply chains just as hyperscalers ramp up AI infrastructure spending.

title: SoftBank Plans $6.3 Billion Retail Bond Sale in Japan
summary: SoftBank Group plans a record ¥1 trillion ($6.3 billion) retail bond sale in Japan, the largest ever by a Japanese issuer, to help fund its investment commitments to OpenAI. The offering underscores the scale of capital SoftBank is committing to the AI buildout.

title: UK Fintech Funding Drops to Lowest Level in At Least a Decade
summary: Investment in UK fintech firms fell to its lowest level since at least 2016 in the first half of the year, as investors redirect capital toward AI-linked companies with clearer long-term growth stories. The decline highlights how the AI boom is reshaping venture funding priorities away from traditional fintech.

title: Hugging Face Gauging Interest for Potential Sale, Business Insider Says
summary: Hugging Face is exploring a potential sale that could value the AI platform at $13 billion or more, Business Insider reported. The move would mark one of the largest exits yet among open-source AI infrastructure companies.

title: Cuattro Casa de Café / Faci Leboreiro
summary: Faci Leboreiro's Cuattro Casa de Café in Troncones, Guerrero, combines a café-restaurant, bakery, artisanal shop, and private office on a sloping coastal lot. The design was built around preserving all existing vegetation and using passive strategies to respond to the tropical climate.

title: ¿Nvidia se convierte en un banco central del gasto tecnológico?
summary: Nvidia anunció un memorando de entendimiento con Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs y KKR para crear plataformas de financiamiento de cómputo capaces de atraer más de US$500,000 millones de capital de terceros. Un informe de Carson Investment cuestiona si Nvidia se está convirtiendo en una especie de “banco central” del gasto en tecnología, ya que la deuda de estas plataformas queda alojada en vehículos de propósito especial.

title: Alibaba Raises $10 Billion in Record Hong Kong Share Sale
summary: Alibaba raised $10.2 billion in Hong Kong's biggest-ever secondary share sale, underscoring its willingness to spend heavily to compete in AI. The stock fell as much as 10% on the news, its steepest drop since April 2025.

title: Hermitage House C70 / ASMD Taller Arquitectura
summary: ASMD Taller Arquitectura transformed a 1960s house in Mérida's historic center through an operation of subtraction, demolishing part of the built volume to recover open space. The move brings light, ventilation, and social life back into the compact urban home.

title: C.E. House / Dall'Ovo Magalhães Arquitetura
summary: Dall'Ovo Magalhães Arquitetura's C.E. House sits on a forested plateau, its horizontal, discreet volume following the natural slope of the land. The design blurs the line between living and contemplating, keeping the home close to the earth while suspended above it.
